# PCGL, Psyk. ambulatorium

PCGL, Psyk. ambulatorium is a psychiatric outpatient clinic ("Psyk. ambulatorium") appearing in the ADHD-databasen 2024 report as one of the units reporting performance on Indikator 10, a quality measure tracking how many adult ADHD treatment courses included an assessment of the patient's social support needs within 120 days of treatment start [^src1]. The clinic's results place it well below the national quality target of 90%.

At its first-listed measurement, PCGL, Psyk. ambulatorium reported a fulfilment rate of 53% (confidence interval 45-61), based on 83 out of 156 treatment courses meeting the criterion [^src1]. A second, closely related data point for the same unit shows a slightly lower rate of 50% (confidence interval 42-58), based on 78 out of 156 courses [^src2]. Both figures fall far short of the 90% developmental target set for Indikator 10 [^src1][^src2].

This shortfall is not unique to PCGL, Psyk. ambulatorium — the broader ADHD-databasen report notes that Indikator 10 was being reported for the first time in 2024, and that both the national average (37%) and the regional range (14-52%) fell well short of the 90% goal [^src1]. The steering group behind the database discussed possible causes for the low fulfilment rates, including registration practices and the underlying data quality from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and decided to work on improving registration practices going forward [^src1]. PCGL, Psyk. ambulatorium's own numbers sit within this pattern of national underperformance on the indicator, rather than as an outlier.
